parts.answer: For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg once daily, the maximum is 50 mg/day, and monitoring requires a recheck in 2-4 weeks. Renal dosing by eGFR category is: Normal (>=90) starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, routine monitoring; Mild (60-89) starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, routine monitoring; Moderate (30-59) starting dose 25 mg once daily, maximum 50 mg/day, recheck 2-4 weeks monitoring; Severe (15-29) specialist review, maximum 25 mg/day, enhanced monitoring. Baseline hepatic laboratory values are required with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21.
